findings.issue: Pause drawer secondary text fails contrast in the dark theme
findings.evidence: Measured 3.1:1 for the drawer's secondary text at 390×844 (WCAG AA needs 4.5:1). This is a shared-shell defect visible in Coil, not a Coil-only stylesheet defect.
findings.fix: Raise the shell's muted text colour in the dark theme; every game inherits it.
findings.note: Outside the Coil owner's folder. Handed to the shell owner with the contrast measurement.

findings.issue: Particles keep moving after reduced motion is turned on mid-game
findings.evidence: With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` emulated during play, the burst particles from a collision kept animating for about 2 s.
findings.fix: Clear live particles when the reduced-motion preference changes, not only when they spawn.
findings.note: Owner reports particles are cleared on the preference change; the reviewer has not re-run the reduced-motion probe.

findings.issue: Canvas redraws every frame while the game is paused
findings.evidence: Paused for 10 s with the drawer open: the performance trace shows a full canvas redraw on every animation frame.
findings.fix: Make canvas timing event-driven while paused: redraw on resize and state changes only.
findings.note: Re-traced after the fix: no redraws while paused, one redraw on resize.

findings.issue: Touch steering target is smaller than 44 px in landscape
findings.evidence: At 844×390 the steering hit area measured 36×36 px.
findings.fix: Give the steering control a 44 px minimum hit area at every viewport.

findings.issue: Snake head overlaps the score HUD at the arena's top edge
findings.evidence: Screenshot at 1440×900: the head drew over the score while hugging the top wall.
findings.fix: Inset the arena by the HUD's height.
findings.note: Arena-only captures at 1440×900 and 390×844 keep the HUD outside the arena bounds. The overlap in the review screenshot is the debug overlay, which ships disabled.

evidence: Reduced motion emulated in DevTools; keyboard and touch input exercised
Real model play not exercised: the inference lane was unavailable during the review
